verses: Aey kapra orhnay walay
Khara hoja aur aagah kerdey
Aur apney rab hi ki baraiyan biyan ker
Apney kapron ko pak rakha ker
Paki ko chor dey
Aur ehsan kerkay ziyadah lenay ki khuwahish na ker
Aur apney rab ki raah mein sabar ker
Pus jab kay soor mein phoonk maari jaye gi
To woh din bara sakht din hoga
Jo kafiron per aasan na hoga
Mujhay aur ussay chor dey jissay mein ney akela peda kiya hai
Aur ussay boht sa maal dey rakha hai
Aur hazir baash farzand bhi
Aur mein ney ussay boht kuch kushadgi dey rakhi hai
Phir bhi uss ki chahat hai kay mein ussay aur ziyadah doon
Nahi nahi, woh humari aayaton ka mukhalif hai
Unqareeb mein ussay aik sakht charhai charhaon ga
Uss ney ghor kerkay tajweez ki
Ussay halakat ho kaisi (tajweez) sochi?
Woh phir ghaarat ho kiss tarah andaza kiya
Uss ney phir dekha
Phir teweri charhai aur mun banaya
Phir peechay hatt gaya aur ghuroor kiya
Aur kehney laga to yeh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai
Siwaye insani kalaam kay kuch bhi nahi hai
Mein unqareeb ussay dozakh mein dalon ga
Aur tujhay kiya khabar kay dozakh kiya cheez hai?
Na woh baqi rakhti hai na chorti hai
Khal ko jholsa deti hai
Aur uss mein unn Ya Seen (farishtay muqarrar) hain

Hum ney dozakh kay daroghay sirf farishtay rakhay hain. Aur hum ney unn ki tadaad sirf kafiron ki aazmaeesh kay liye muqarrar ki hai takay ahl kitab yaqeen kerlen, ahl eman kay eman mein izafa ho jaye aur ahl kitab aur ahl eman shak na keren aur jin kay dilon mein beemari hai woh aur kafir kahen kay uss biyan say Allah Taalaa ki kiya murad hai? Ussi tarah Allah Taalaa jissay chahata hai gumrah kerta hai aur jissay chahata hai hidayat deta hai. Teray rab kay lashkaron ko uss kay siwa koi nahi janta, yeh to kul bani Adam kay liye sirasir pind o naseehat hai
Sach kehta hun qasam hai chand ki
Aur raat ki jab woh peechay hatay
Aur subha ki jab kay roshan ho jaye
Kay (yaqeenan woh jahannum) bari cheezon mein say aik hai
Bani Adam ko daraney wali
(yani) ussay jo tum mein say aagay barhna chahaye ya peechay hatt na chahaye
Her shakhs apney aemaal kay badlay mein girwi hai
Magar dayen hath walay
Kay woh bahishton mein (bethay huye) gunah gaaron say
Sawal kertay hun gay
Tumhen dozakh mein kiss cheez ney dala
Woh jawab den gay kay hum namazi na thay
Na miskeenon ko khana khilatay thay
Aur hum behas kerney walay (waly(inkarion) ka sath dey ker behas mubahisay mein mashghool raha kertay thay
Aur roz jaza ko jhutlatay thay
Yahan tak kay humen maut aagaee
Pus unhen sifarish kerney walon ki sifarish nafa na dey gi
Unhen kiya ho gaya hai? Kay naseehat say mun mor rahey hain
Goya kay woh bidkay huye gadhay hain
Jo sher say bhagay hun
Balkay)yeh unn mein say her shakhs chahata hai kay ussay khulli hui kitaben di jayen
Hergiz aisa nahi (hosakta balkay)yeh) yeh qayamat say bey khof hain
Sachi baat to yeh hai kay yeh (Quran) aik naseehat hai
Abb jo chahaye uss say naseehat hasil keray
Aur woh uss waqt naseehat hasil keren gay jab Allah Taalaa chahaye, woh ussi laeeq hai kay uss say daren aur uss laeeq bhi kay woh bakhshay
